question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Experiance"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Experience"**.
 
• **"Experience"** refers to the knowledge or skill acquired by a period of practical experience of something, especially that gained in a particular profession. (अनुभव)
 
 
• **Example:** His experience in the field of medicine is unparalleled.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sergeant** (सार्जेंट): A rank in the army or police.

 
 
• **Example:** The sergeant gave clear instructions to his team.
 
 
 
• **Playwright** (नाटककार): A person who writes plays.
 
 
• **Example:** Shakespeare is one of the most famous playwrights in history.
 
 
 
• **Leisure** (फुर्सत): Free time when one is not working or occupied.
 
 
• **Example:** She spends her leisure time reading books.
